The '''Koolach system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was the origin point of [[koolach silk]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|224|koolach silk}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[koolach silk]]|system=Koolach [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Koolach [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" />
